ignore-source.notes: Requires git to be installed for .gitignore handling

ignore-scope-leak.notes: Tests ignore scope isolation across sibling directories

hidden-files.notes: Hidden files (dot-prefix) work on all Unix-like systems

symlink-traversal.notes: Symlink creation and traversal tests. On Windows, requires developer mode or elevated privileges.

one-device.notes: One-device test requires /dev/shm (Linux tmpfs) to have a cross-device mount point. macOS uses a different tmpfs layout and may not have a suitable cross-device boundary. This fixture is Linux-specific.

large-file.notes: Large-file fixture is ~2MB; should work on all platforms
